Class LobbyManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.controller.LobbyManager
public class LobbyManager extends Object
Manages N simultaneous lobbies (GameController instances). Responsibilities: - createLobby(String, int, VirtualView) → called by the first player or by a player who wants a new lobby - joinSpecificLobby(String, int, VirtualView) → client picks and joins an existing lobby - getActiveLobbies() → snapshot of all active lobbies (open + in progress) - placeTotem/pickCard → find the player's lobby and delegate to it There is exactly one LobbyManager per server instance.

  • Method Details

    • createLobby

      public void createLobby(String nickname, int numPlayers, VirtualView caller)
      Creates a new lobby and registers the first player. Finished lobbies are cleaned up first to prevent memory leaks.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the creating player's nickname
      numPlayers - the total number of players expected in the game
      caller - the creating player's VirtualView

    • joinSpecificLobby

      public void joinSpecificLobby(String nickname, int lobbyId, VirtualView caller)
      Adds a client to a specific lobby chosen by ID. The CLI shows an ordered list; the GUI uses a button.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the joining player's nickname
      lobbyId - 1-based ID of the target lobby
      caller - the joining player's VirtualView

    • getActiveLobbies

      public List<LobbyManager.LobbyInfo> getActiveLobbies()
      Returns a snapshot of all active lobbies. Lobbies with inProgress=false are still open for new players; lobbies with inProgress=true are running games that accept spectators.
      Returns:
      list of LobbyManager.LobbyInfo records for open and in-progress lobbies

    • placeTotem

      public void placeTotem(String nickname, char letter)
      Delegates a totem-placement action to the lobby that contains the given player.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the acting player's nickname
      letter - the letter of the target offer space

    • pickCard

      public void pickCard(String nickname, int cardIndex, boolean fromTop)
      Delegates a card-pick action to the lobby that contains the given player.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the acting player's nickname
      cardIndex - 0-based index of the card in the chosen row
      fromTop - true for the top row, false for the bottom row
